description:
## Problem (reproduced on chDB)
ClickHouse (local, server, cloud) and StarRocks pass `tuning_config` to `DataLoader` (`clickhouse/workload.py:709-715`, `starrocks/workload.py:475-481`). After each load, the shared `SortedIngestionMixin.apply_ctas_sort` calls `_build_ctas_sort_sql`, gets `None` (default at `sorted_ingestion.py:429`), and records the dropped intent `sorted_ingestion <t> ORDER BY …` / "ClickHouse Local does not support CTAS sort" (`sorted_ingestion.py:144-152`). The sort was already realized by `ORDER BY` DDL and corroborated in the catalog, but any dropped intent vetoes `applied_verified`. ClickHouse can never verify.

Also, with the opt-in `sorted_ingestion_mode` off, Athena, Synapse, Snowflake and Databricks report the misleading reason "does not support CTAS sort".

## Change
- Make the capability registry state sorting `rendered_via="ddl"` for ClickHouse and StarRocks.
- When `_build_ctas_sort_sql` returns `None` and the registry says sorting renders via DDL, record nothing, or the D-6 non-blocking `satisfied_by`.
- When the mode is off, the reason is `sorted_ingestion_mode=off`.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- A sort requested on a platform that neither renders it via DDL nor CTAS still records a drop.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
